title: Valid Palindrome String
description:
Given a string S, check if it is a palindrome. Consider only alphanumeric characters and ignore case.

A palindrome reads same forward and backward after removing non-alphanumeric characters.

Input Format:
Single line containing string S (may contain spaces)

Output Format:
Print "true" if palindrome else "false" (lowercase)

Constraints:
1 <= |S| <= 10^5

Example 1:
Input:
A man, a plan, a canal: Panama
Output:
true

Example 2:
Input:
race a car
Output:
false

testcases.input: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama
